one_month_reasoning: No TT earnings in the window (Q4 results late January 2027). In the window: the ~$256M debenture put settlement in November (no material election, 10-Q), Nvidia's quarterly results in the second half of November (AI data-center sentiment; the January Vera Rubin 'no chillers' remark cost TT 4-8% in a day), and macro prints. Short-horizon regularities pull both ways: a guidance-driven sell-off after a beat (-8.6% from $448.47 to $410) tends to drift, but a sharp two-day drop on a reaffirmed guide also mean-reverts. Net: centred on $410 with ~9% monthly sigma (30%/3.5 = 8.6%, nudged up for the Nvidia event) and slightly fat tails. Round 2: unchanged - the revision moves the 12-month view, not the window's events.

reasoning: Skeptic lane, round 2. Round-1 evidence stands: the Q3 2026 beat was tax-aided (17.3% adjusted ETR), the guided +50bp margin came in -40bp, FY price was cut to ~1pt and leverage to 'low 20s', and the reaffirmed $15.20-15.30 implies Q4 $3.40-3.50 vs 3.59 Street (supervisor confirmed), hence -8.6% on the 'beat'. Cash flow is flattered by customer deposits (+$835M) and supplier finance (+$148M YTD; 393.1 kept in net debt). Americas book-to-bill fell to 101%; >$8B of the $12.5B backlog ships 2027+ but only >$1B in 2028; Bernstein sees 35-40% of announced capacity at risk of delay. Changes from the supervisor's findings: (1) the -1.25x long-dated haircut is dropped - the own multiple was set by a market that already knew the Vera Rubin and Bernstein news, so it double-counted; I keep the skeptic view in a wider downside case (-4 turns to ~the peer median) instead. (2) The unsourced $1.5B ACC tail is removed; the $742.5M court estimate could not be shown from the 10-Q (fetch truncated; the 10-K note gives no amount) so it is out of the numbers; asbestos is carried at the sourced 545-270 = 275. (3) NCI moved to an equity adjustment at market (-488) on both legs. (4) EV/EBITDA leg re-anchored on filing peers (LII/SPXC 14.1x LTM GAAP, own 20.5x, k=0.8 -> 19.0x). (5) Tax 19.0% FY27-28. Kept against the supervisor: FY27 Americas growth +10% (vs its +11%) and margin +25bp (vs +30bp), because Q3 book-to-bill was ~1 and 2028 visibility is thin; own NTM P/E 23.77x on the re-pulled Nasdaq quarterlies (not 23.96x) and the gate-ready 18.3x peer median (not 18.45x). Research target (12m) $424.90 (+3.6% vs $410); downside case $280.29 (-34%), upside case $545.29 (+28%): a fatter left tail. Research for round 2: ~8 queries (10-Q and 10-K asbestos text, Q3 release NCI line, Nasdaq consensus re-pull, post-print downgrade search; two Mizuho/Baird target-cut hits were from 2024-25 and not used). All legs driver-linked; no custom per-share legs.

model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led quarterly segment build (Americas, EMEA, Asia Pacific; 6 drivers: segment revenue and GAAP segment operating margin; corporate expense a cited constant) covering 100% of revenue, reproducing FY2025 exactly (21,321.9 revenue, 3,967.4 EBIT) and the three reported 2026 quarters. Value carried by an NTM P/E horizon leg (0.75) on the build's own GAAP EPS and an LTM GAAP EV/EBITDA cross-check (0.25) anchored on filing peers; no DCF (policy), no SOTP (not a conglomerate). Equity adjustments: NCI at market (-488) and asbestos to the $545M plan (-275).
